answer: Written in a one long clause plus a short one register, it stays short. The design leans on cost-of-replication accounting, diluted when peers disagree, no identity may audit its own recruit. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the wander of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The thread lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the falcon is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Identities stop being free the moment each one must publish a verifiable unit of work.
